node.title: Re: Merge hashrefs into one
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: $var1, $var2, and $var3 are each array references that you need to dereference to get their elements. {$var1, $var2, $var3} constructs an anonymous hash, not an array, you want [] instead. my $data = [@$var1, @$var2, @$var3]; produces your expected output. References: [doc://perldsc], [doc://perlreftut], [doc://perlref].
